gloss: completely; without omission; in full; leaving nothing out

definitions.gloss: completely; without omission; in full; leaving nothing out
definitions.explanation: An adverbial expression meaning to do something thoroughly, covering every aspect without leaving anything remaining or unused.

examples.japanese: {才能|さいのう}を{余|あま}すところなく{発揮|はっき}した。
examples.english: He demonstrated his talent to the fullest.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}は{日本|にほん}の{歴史|れきし}を{余|あま}すところなく{紹介|しょうかい}している。
examples.english: This book introduces Japanese history in its entirety.

examples.japanese: {素材|そざい}の{味|あじ}を{余|あま}すところなく{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す{料理法|りょうりほう}を{学|まな}びたい。
examples.english: I want to learn cooking techniques that bring out the full flavor of the ingredients.

notes:
Literally "leaving no remainder," from {余|あま}す (to leave over) + ところ (aspect; part) + なく (without). A somewhat literary adverbial expression that emphasizes thoroughness and completeness. Often used in written or formal speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {才能|さいのう}を{余|あま}すところなく{発揮|はっき}する: to demonstrate one's talent fully
- {魅力|みりょく}を{余|あま}すところなく{伝|つた}える: to convey the appeal completely
- {余|あま}すところなく{紹介|しょうかい}する: to introduce in full
- {力|ちから}を{余|あま}すところなく{出|だ}す: to put out all one's strength

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {残|のこ}らず: without exception; all of them — focuses on not leaving any items behind
- {十分|じゅうぶん}に: sufficiently; fully — less emphatic, more everyday
- くまなく: thoroughly; in every corner — emphasizes searching or covering every area
